units.source_text: 进行到中盘时，每下一手都相当困难。

en.t: Once the game reached the middle stage, every move became quite difficult.

units.source_text: 黑白的范围大致分明了。

en.t: The territories of Black and White had become roughly clear.

units.source_text: 结局如何还无法准确估计，但眼下快到可以估计的时候了。

en.t: It was still impossible to judge the final outcome accurately, but the moment when it could be judged was now close at hand.

units.source_text: 就这样进入收官或是杀入敌阵，或是在某处挑战？

en.t: Should he proceed into the endgame like this, cut into the enemy position, or challenge somewhere else?

units.source_text: 这时候可以看出这盘棋的大势，拟定作战步骤，判断胜负了。

en.t: At this point, one could see the general course of the game, plan the sequence of operations, and judge victory or defeat.
